backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing implemented logo asset generation and brand asset path updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Aggregated one-line summaries of all key frontend files and their roles in the project.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide outlining build checks, common blockers, and configuration requirements.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS setup defining OKLCH color tokens and base styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component assembling header, content sections, and footer.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Client-side validated contact form with input fields, error handling, and simulated submission.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section displaying mission content and three core values with icons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Renders the contact section with email, address, phone info, and a contact form, including phone sanitization for tel links.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Displays the hero banner with background image, headline text, and CTA buttons that smoothly scroll to sections.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a grid of service cards using mapped icons and marketing copy-driven content.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with brand text, navigation links, social icons, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with logo, navigation links, scroll behavior, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts: Exports centralized paths for large and standard logo assets.
frontend/src/content/marketingCopy.ts: Provides static marketing text for hero, about, services, and contact sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the user's identity, refetching dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context for login, logout, and persisted identity handling via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains placeholder structure for future query hooks that depend on the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark agricultural-themed color schemes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, QueryClientProvider, and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling dark mode, custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and extended theme settings.
frontend/tsconfig.node.json: TypeScript config for Vite’s Node environment with ESNext modules and bundler resolution.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite config enabling React, path aliasing, build output settings, and a dev server on port 3000.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing current features, logo-related requirements, and pending feature requests.
